headline: Rupee Rush teaser and release-backed update news

changes.title: Rupee Rush is coming
changes.detail: A new gem-themed game teaser banner has been added to Nut Buster's home screen.

changes.title: What's new on the home screen
changes.detail: A compact scrolling news ticker and expandable changes list now travel with each packaged release.

changes.title: Every published update needs real notes
changes.detail: Release tests reject reused, empty, invented, or unrelated changelog entries; the publisher embeds the validated news and publishes matching release notes.
